cards.text: In Caesarea, the Holy Spirit fell on a houseful of Gentiles while Peter, one of Jesus' apostles, was still speaking (Acts 10:44). Word gets around, and nobody even needed a group chat. The apostles and brothers throughout Judea hear that the Gentiles also received the word of God.
So when Peter goes up to Jerusalem, the circumcised believers take issue with him. I bet Peter was hoping for a welcome home party, and instead he walks into a MEETING.

cards.question: The circumcised believers in Jerusalem have a complaint for Peter. What is it?

answers.text: He visited uncircumcised men and ate with them
He baptized people without asking the apostles
He stayed away from Jerusalem far too long

cards.question: True or false: Peter refuses to answer the believers in Jerusalem and walks out.
Peter tells the believers in Jerusalem he was praying in Joppa when, in a trance, he saw a vision. What came down from heaven by its four corners?

cards.text: Peter looked closely at the sheet and saw four-footed animals, wild beasts, reptiles and birds of the air. Reptiles, friend. Coming down out of the sky. On a SHEET.

cards.question: Peter is looking at a sheet of animals let down from heaven. Then he hears a voice. What does it tell him?

answers.text: Get up and kill and eat
Lead them up to the temple

cards.question: Peter answers the voice, "No, Lord," and gives a reason. What is it?

answers.text: Nothing impure has ever entered his mouth
He has been fasting since early that morning
He has never killed an animal himself

cards.question: True or false: the voice speaks from heaven a second time and tells Peter, "Do not call anything impure that God has made clean."

cards.text: This happens three times, and then everything is drawn back up into heaven. Gone, faster than a fresh batch off my cooling rack when a baker walks by.
JUST THEN, three men sent from Caesarea stop at the house where Peter is staying. My oven timer has never once been that on time.

cards.question: The Spirit tells Peter what to do about the three men from Caesarea. What is it?

cards.text: Six brothers went with Peter, and they all entered the home of Cornelius, a centurion in Caesarea (Acts 10:1). Cornelius told them he had seen an angel standing in his house.

cards.question: True or false: Cornelius says the angel told him to send to Joppa for Simon who is called Peter.

cards.text: The angel had also said Peter would bring a message by which Cornelius and all his household would be saved. Now THAT is a message worth the trip.
Then Peter tells them the big moment: as he began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell upon them. Friend, Peter didn't even make it to his second point.

cards.question: Peter says the Holy Spirit fell on the people in Cornelius's house. How does that compare with how He fell on Peter and the other believers at the beginning?

cards.text: Then Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how He said, "John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit." One of those moments where it all clicks at once.

cards.question: God gave the Gentiles the same gift He gave those who believed in the Lord Jesus Christ. So what does Peter ask the believers in Jerusalem?

answers.text: Who was he to hinder God's work

cards.question: True or false: after hearing Peter out, the believers in Jerusalem keep arguing with him.
Their objections are gone. What do the believers in Jerusalem do instead?

cards.text: And they say it out loud: "So then, God has granted even the Gentiles repentance unto life." EVEN the Gentiles, friend. Somebody grab the sprinkles.
